target.body:
## Summary

- update `@earendil-works/pi-tui` 0.80.6 → 0.80.9
- update Oxfmt 0.58.0 → 0.59.0 and Oxlint 1.73.0 → 1.74.0
- update Vite 8.1.4 → 8.1.5

These are the remaining compatible direct updates not already covered by open Dependabot PRs. The existing Unreleased changelog already records compatible runtime/tooling refreshes.

## Upstream review

- Pi TUI adds terminal tab normalization and legacy alt-prefixed symbol parsing fixes: https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/releases/tag/v0.80.9
- Oxfmt adds CSS/Less and TypeScript formatting support plus comment/parens correctness fixes; Oxlint adds rules/fixes and configuration correctness improvements: https://github.com/oxc-project/oxc/releases/tag/apps_v1.74.0
- Vite 8.1.5 is a bug-fix release covering bundled-dev, optimizer interop, module-runner source maps, and SSR scoping: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/releases/tag/v8.1.5

## Proof

- `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`: passed with pnpm 10.34.3.
- `pnpm run build`: passed.
- `pnpm run typecheck`: passed.
- `pnpm run lint`: passed; Oxfmt 0.59.0 reported all 235 files correctly formatted and Oxlint emitted no warnings.
- `pnpm exec vitest --config vitest.config.ci.ts`: 113 files passed, 2 skipped; 702 tests passed, 31 skipped.
- `pnpm run build:bun:test`: built and executed both standalone binaries; both reported 2.1.2.
- `pnpm audit --audit-level high`: no known vulnerabilities.
- Real TUI proof in tmux: the panel rendered its full target/status/log/control layout using Pi TUI 0.80.9; raw input recorded refresh byte `72` (`r`) and quit byte `71` (`q`); process exited 0.
- AutoReview: `~/.claude/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` returned clean with no accepted/actionable findings (overall correctness 0.99).

## Remaining policy exceptions

- PostCSS 8.5.19, tsx 4.23.1, and the final TypeScript native-preview 7.0 snapshot remain in their dedicated open Dependabot PRs.
- TypeScript 7.0.2 remains deferred under the repository's established stable-TypeScript/native-preview policy.

target.title: test: stabilize build error persistence wait
target.body:
## Summary

- wait for the persisted build-error field, not merely for any state object
- keep timeout behavior so a missing persistence update still fails the existing assertions
- remove a race observed while validating the dependency queue

## Root cause

`initializeState()` makes `readState()` truthy before `updateBuildError()` finishes. The test helper returned on that initial state, so the fixed 50 ms delay sometimes left `lastBuildError` undefined. The helper now accepts a readiness predicate and waits for the field the test actually asserts.

## Proof

- Reproduced before the patch during the PR 180 full suite: `expected undefined to be defined` at `test/build-improvements.test.ts:217`.
- Focused test passed 15 consecutive stress runs after the patch. A later run under severe unrelated host CPU saturation timed out in a different test; the final normal focused run passed all 7 tests.
- `pnpm run build`: passed.
- `pnpm run typecheck`: passed.
- `pnpm run lint`: passed.
- `pnpm exec vitest --config vitest.config.ci.ts`: 113 files passed, 2 skipped; 702 tests passed, 31 skipped.
- `pnpm run build:bun:test`: built and executed both standalone binaries; both reported 2.1.2.
- `pnpm audit --audit-level high`: no known vulnerabilities.
- `~/.claude/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local`: clean, no accepted/actionable findings; overall correctness 0.98.

Test-only change; no changelog entry.
